# Joshua Stein PLLC

> A New York-based commercial real estate law firm specializing in ground leases, hotel transactions, and real estate financing.

Joshua Stein PLLC provides specialized legal services in commercial real estate with deep expertise in ground leases, hotel development, and complex real estate transactions. The firm is recognized in leading legal directories including Chambers USA, Super Lawyers, and Who's Who Legal.
